name: Northland Auto & Truck Accessories
description: Northland Automotive is a full-service accessories shop located in Billings Montana. We are a family owned and operated business that has been around for over 40 years. We have a very knowledgeable staff that have well over 150 years of combined industry experience. We have 4 full time shop technicians that install everything we sell. We offer a very wide variety of products from the top manufactures in the industry. We have over 100 manufactures that we can choose from, and we only sell the best rated products available. Northland Automotive has over a 15,000 sq ft. warehouse with a complete inventory of products in stock. We realize we can't stock every product, so we have agreements with other vendors and warehouses that we can pull product & parts from in order to service our customers in a timely manner.
